title: Explore the Future AI World — AIGC100 Awards Now Open for Nominations
summary: Domestic AI heat keeps rising as frontier tech becomes products users can feel. Baidu, Baichuan and peers passed generative-AI service filing and opened to the public—monthly plans, travel itineraries, lyrics, RFPs. Time’s AI 100 includes Altman, Robin Li, Hassabis, Musk, Kai-Fu
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Event / AIGC100 signup · September 11, 2023 · KEEP event signup CTA

Domestic AI heat keeps rising as frontier tech becomes products users can feel. Baidu, Baichuan and peers passed generative-AI service filing and opened to the public—monthly plans, travel itineraries, lyrics, RFPs. Time’s AI 100 includes Altman, Robin Li, Hassabis, Musk, Kai-Fu Lee, Andrew Ng, Jensen Huang. Huang’s “AI’s iPhone moment” and NVIDIA’s Q2 letter: companies shifting from general-purpose to accelerated computing and generative AI.

Baidu stands out with full-stack apps/models/frameworks/chips; Ernie Bot opened broadly Aug 31. IDC: China is the world’s second-largest AI market. Andrew Ng: huge opportunity across healthcare, finance, education, entertainment, transport, agriculture.

Gartner: AI-generated data <1% of all data now → ~10% by 2025. Toubao: China AIGC market to RMB 267.4B by 2027 (2022–27 CAGR 105%). Unique Research just published China AIGC Industry Map V3.0.

Mission: accelerate healthy AI apps. When founders face doubt, external recognition fuels resilience—and industry hears their voice. Unique Capital launches AIGC100 to discover high-potential domestic AI applications.

Nominate / apply: Explore the future AI world—find unlimited innovative apps. The next AI unicorn may be here. Contact Unique Capital / Unique Research AIGC100 team to submit.

2 CN images; attach on ingest.

— END —
